entries.title: Agent match rules match on `admin_status` and `provision_status`
entries.description: `TelemetryAgentMatchRuleBase` and `CollectionAgentMatchRuleBase` replace the `status` field with `admin_status` and `provision_status` (both `str | None`). Rules that set `status` must be rewritten to use one or both.

entries.title: Node `status` split into `admin_status` and `provision_status`
entries.description: `NodeBase`, `NodeUpdate` and the node list/detail responses no longer have `status`; they have `admin_status` (`NodeAdminStatus`: `planned`, `active`, `decommissioned`) and `provision_status` (`NodeProvisionStatus`). The old `init` value is gone and `NodeStatus` is removed from `acex_devkit.models`: use the two new enums. This is also a change to the backend and client API.

entries.title: Set an agent's explicit nodes in one call: `AgentNodeSet`
entries.description: New models `AgentNodeSet` (`node_ids`, optional `expected_revision`) and `AgentNodeSetResult` (`added`, `removed`, `config_revision`), exported from `acex_devkit.models`. `node_ids` replaces the agent's explicit node links and an empty list removes them all; rule-matched nodes are unaffected. Per the docstring, a differing `expected_revision` is rejected with 409.

entries.title: `TelemetryAgentResponse.node_coverage` shows what is rendered per node
entries.description: New `NodeCoverage` (`node_id`, `hostname`, `source`: `explicit`/`rule`/`both`, `capabilities`) and `CapabilityCoverage` (`status`: `rendered`/`skipped`, `reason`, `detail`). `TelemetryAgentResponse.node_coverage` is filled only when a single agent is read and is empty in listings.

entries.title: `NodeListItem.management_connections` lists a node's management connections
entries.description: `NodeListItem` gains `management_connections: list[ManagementConnectionResponse]` (default empty), so the node list carries each node's management connections, including the target IP, without a per-node request.

entries.title: Dependency constraints no longer have an upper bound
entries.description: `pydantic`, `typing-extensions`, `deepdiff`, `ipaddress` and `sqlmodel` change from caret ranges (for example `^2.12.5`) to lower bounds only (`>=2.12.5`). The minimum versions are unchanged, but a resolver may now pick a newer major release than before; Python stays `^3.13`.

releases.summary: Assets use typed vendors and operating systems, and a hardware catalog and OS version schemes are declared.

entries.title: `Asset` uses typed `Vendor` and `OS`; `os_version` is optional and checked
entries.description: `Asset`, `AssetCreate` and `AssetUpdate` take `vendor: Vendor` and `os: OS` (new enums in `acex_devkit.models.platform`) instead of free strings, and the defaults for `vendor`, `serial_number`, `os` and `hardware_model` are gone, so they are required on create. `os_version` is now `str | None`, default `None`, and is validated against the version scheme of the asset's `os`. Callers that sent other vendor/OS strings or relied on the old defaults must change; this is also a backend and client API change.

entries.title: Declared hardware catalog: `DeviceType` and `acex_devkit.device_types`
entries.description: Hardware models are declared as `DeviceType` subclasses (vendor, `os`, `models`, front-panel `ports` as `PortGroup`, `slots` as `ModuleSlot`) for Cisco, Juniper and Fortinet, and `PortModule` declares pluggable modules. Look them up with `device_types.get(model)`, `device_types.models(vendor=..., os=...)`, `vendors()` and `port_modules(fits=...)`; `DeviceType.interfaces()` expands a device into zero-based `InterfaceSlot` positions. Interface names and offsets stay the driver's job.

entries.title: OS version schemes: `OsVersion` and `OsVersionScheme`
entries.description: New `OsVersion` (comparable `major`, `minor`, `patch`, `build`, `qualifier`) and `OsVersionScheme`, one per OS, declared in `acex_devkit.os_versions` for `cisco_ios`, `cisco_iosxe`, `cisco_iosxr`, `cisco_nxos`, `juniper_junos`, `fortinet_fortios` and `arista_eos`. A new OS needs a scheme to accept a version on an `Asset`; a new release of a known OS needs nothing.

entries.title: `AssetClusterCreate.asset_ids` creates a cluster with its assets
entries.description: `AssetClusterCreate` gains `asset_ids: list[int]` (default empty), so a cluster and its assets are created in one request. Per the PR, the backend answers 409 if one of the assets already belongs to another cluster.

entries.title: `OutputDestination*` models and `TelemetryAgentResponse.outputs` removed
entries.description: `OutputDestinationBase`, `OutputDestinationCreate`, `OutputDestinationUpdate` and `OutputDestinationResponse` are gone from `acex_devkit.models`, as is the `outputs` field on `TelemetryAgentResponse`. Outputs are no longer configured per agent but by the backend's InfluxDB settings; remove any code that creates or reads per-agent outputs.

entries.title: AI requests can name a model; provider and model listing models added
entries.description: `AiAskRequest` and `AiAnalysisRequest` gain `model: str | None` ("provider/model" or "model"); left out, the failover chain is used. New response models `AiProvidersResponse` (`providers`, per-task `chains`), `AiProviderInfo`, `AiModelsResponse`, `AiModelInfo` and `AiChainLevel` describe `GET /ai_ops/providers` and `GET /ai_ops/models`.

entries.title: Telemetry agents get SNMP trap and syslog receiver settings
entries.description: `TelemetryAgentBase`, `TelemetryAgentUpdate` and `TelemetryAgentResponse` gain `snmp_version` (`SnmpVersion`: `2c`, `3`, `both`; default `2c`), `snmp_trap_port` (162), `syslog_port` (514), `snmpv3_sec_level` (`SnmpSecLevel`), `snmpv3_sec_name`, `snmpv2c_credential_id` and `snmpv3_credential_id`. `SnmpVersion` and `SnmpSecLevel` live in `acex_devkit.models.telemetry_agent`.

entries.title: `CredentialCreate` validates SNMPv3 `auth_protocol` and `priv_protocol` values
entries.description: New enums `SnmpAuthProtocol` (`MD5`, `SHA`, `SHA224` … `SHA512`) and `SnmpPrivProtocol` (`DES`, `AES`, `AES192`, `AES192C`, `AES256`, `AES256C`) in `acex_devkit.models.credential`. A `CredentialCreate` of type `snmpv3` whose `auth_protocol` or `priv_protocol` is not one of them now fails validation; empty or missing values are still accepted.

entries.title: `enabled` on NTP, SNMP and AAA global config now defaults to unset
entries.description: `NtpConfig.enabled`, `SnmpConfig.enabled` and `aaaGlobalAttributes.enabled` changed from `AttributeValue(value=False)` (or `False`) to `None` by default, like the other `enabled` attributes. A renderer or parser that read `.enabled.value` without a check must now handle `None`, and a device with the feature off no longer shows an explicit `False` unless it is set.

entries.title: Create and update models for nodes, assets, sites, regions and contacts
entries.description: New request models exported from `acex_devkit.models`: `AssetCreate`, `AssetUpdate`, `LogicalNodeUpdate`, `NodeCreate`, `NodeUpdate`, `ManagementConnectionCreate`, `ManagementConnectionUpdate`, `SiteCreate`, `SiteUpdate`, `RegionCreate`, `RegionUpdate`, `ContactCreate`, `ContactUpdate`, plus `RegionAssignmentCreate/Response` and `ContactAssignmentCreate/Response`. The `*Update` models have every field optional, so only fields sent are changed.

entries.title: Models for telemetry agents and collection agents
entries.description: New `telemetry_agent` models (`TelemetryAgentCreate`, `TelemetryAgentUpdate`, `TelemetryAgentResponse`, `TelemetryAgentAck`, match rules, `OutputDestination*`, `InfluxDBVersion`), `TelemetryCapability` (`icmp`, `mdt`, `snmp`, `snmp_trap`, `syslog_rfc5424`), `CollectionAgentManifest` with `ManifestTarget`, `AckResult`, `AgentConfigResponse`, and `CollectionAgentAck` / `CollectionAgentMatchRuleCreate`. Agent match rules select nodes by `region`, `site`, `vendor`, `os`, `status` and `role`.

entries.title: Response models for config snapshots, compliance, LLDP topology and AI ops
entries.description: New models for backend endpoints: `ConfigSnapshotDetail`, `ConfigDiffResult`, `ConfigChangeListResult`, `DeviceConfigUpload` (`config_snapshot`); `ComplianceResult`, `SiteComplianceResult`; `LldpTopology` and `LldpUploadResult`; `ConfigComponentCatalogEntry`, `TranslateRequest`, `ReconcileRequest` (`config_components`); `AiAskRequest`, `AiAnalysisRequest`; and `AuthConfig`. These describe the backend API as the client consumes it.

entries.title: `PersistedResponse` models can be built from ORM objects; `sqlmodel` declared
entries.description: `PersistedResponse` now sets `from_attributes=True`, so every response model derived from it can be validated directly from an object's attributes. `sqlmodel` (`^0.0.27`) is added to the package dependencies; `ExternalValue` already depended on it.

entries.title: `ConfigDiffer` tolerates a missing configuration section
entries.description: The differ's internal walk (`_flatten`) now returns nothing for a `None` model instead of trying to read its fields, so comparing a composed configuration where a whole section is unset no longer fails.

entries.title: AAA authentication, authorization and accounting `config` is now a keyed entry
entries.description: `aaaAuthentication.config`, `aaaAuthorization.config` and `aaaAccounting.config` are no longer dicts of methods: each is now a single `aaaAuthenticationConfig`, `aaaAuthorizationConfig` or `aaaAccountingConfig` with `name` and a `methods` dict (authorization and accounting also hold `events` there). Code that indexed `config[<list name>]` must read `config.methods[<list name>]` instead.

entries.title: `aaaGlobalAttributes`, `Console` and `VtyLine` can be keyed and augmented
entries.description: `aaaGlobalAttributes` becomes a `ContainerEntry` with a `name` identity field, `Console` becomes a `ContainerEntry` (identity `name`) and `Augmentable`, and `VtyLine` is now `Augmentable`, so vendor augments (such as the Cisco AAA augments from the same PR) can attach to them and the differ can match them by identity.

entries.title: `configuration` moved from `LogicalNodeResponse` to `LogicalNodeConfigResponse`
entries.description: `LogicalNodeResponse` moved to `acex_devkit.models.logical_node` and holds `hostname`, `role`, `site`, `sequence` and `regions` only. The `configuration` (`ComposedConfiguration`) and `meta_data` fields are on the new `LogicalNodeConfigResponse`; `LogicalNodeListResponse` and `LogicalNodeCreate` are also new.

entries.title: `ManagementConnection` is now an alias of `ManagementConnectionResponse`
entries.description: `ManagementConnection` is kept as an alias of `ManagementConnectionResponse`, which requires `id` and `node_id`; the editable fields (`primary`, `connection_type`, `target_ip`) are in `ManagementConnectionBase`. `NodeListItem` and `NodeResponse` gain `regions`, and `NodeListItem` gains `role`.

entries.title: Node, asset and logical node models reorganised; `id` is now required
entries.description: `Asset`, `AssetCluster` and `AssetClusterAsset` leave `node_response`; use `Asset`, `AssetResponse`, `AssetClusterResponse` and `AssetClusterAssetResponse` from `acex_devkit.models.asset`, and `Node` is removed in favour of `NodeResponse` and `NodeListItem`. Responses now derive from `PersistedResponse`, so `id` is an `int` instead of `Optional`, and `NodeResponse.asset` is `AssetResponse | AssetClusterResponse`. This is also a change to the backend and client API.

entries.title: Models for credentials, agents, LLDP neighbours, sites, regions and paging
entries.description: `acex_devkit.models` now exports `CredentialCreate`, `CredentialResponse`, `CredentialSecret`, `NodeCredentialCreate`, `CollectionAgentCreate`, `CollectionAgentResponse`, `LldpNeighborUpload`, `LldpNeighborResponse`, `SiteResponse`, `RegionResponse`, `ContactResponse`, `PaginatedResponse` (`items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`), `AssetClusterCreate` and `AssetClusterUpdate`, among others. They are the shapes the backend API and client use.

entries.title: Drivers can raise `ConnectionTimeout` and `AuthenticationFailed`
entries.description: Two new exceptions in `acex_devkit.exceptions`, both subclasses of `ConnectionError`: `ConnectionTimeout` for a connection attempt or operation that times out, and `AuthenticationFailed` for rejected device authentication. Existing `except ConnectionError` handlers still catch them; raise them from a transport to let callers tell the causes apart.

entries.title: `Services` fields moved under `Services.config`; `Ssh.config` has a default
entries.description: `name`, `http` and `https` are no longer on `Services`; read them from `Services.config` (a `ServicesAttributes`, always present). `Ssh.config` now defaults to an empty `SshServer()` instead of `None`.

entries.title: SNMP models lose the `Attributes` suffix again
entries.description: Relative to 1.16.x: `SnmpConfigAttributes`, `SnmpCommunityAttributes`, `SnmpGroupAttributes`, `SnmpUserAttributes`, `SnmpServerAttributes` and `TrapEventAttributes` are named `SnmpConfig`, `SnmpCommunity`, `SnmpGroup`, `SnmpUser`, `SnmpServer` and `TrapEvent`, and `SnmpViewOidAttributes` is `SnmpView`. Imports of the 1.16.x names must be updated; `SnmpViewAttributes` keeps its name.

entries.title: `System.clock` with `ClockConfig.timezone`
entries.description: The composed `System` gains `clock: Clock` (default `Clock()`), whose `config` is a `ClockConfig` with `timezone: AttributeValue[str] | None`. A renderer can use it for the device's clock timezone.

entries.title: Augment base classes moved to `models.augment`; more components augmentable
entries.description: `AugmentAttributes` and `Augmentable` move to the new module `acex_devkit.models.augment` (extra fields are kept, so backend-defined subclasses round-trip). `SystemConfig`, `SshServer`, `LoggingConfig`, `Console`, `FileLogging`, `DHCPSnoopingAttributes` and the new `ServicesAttributes` are now `Augmentable`, so a driver can read vendor augments from their `augments` dict.

entries.title: Importing the composed configuration models no longer raises `NameError`
entries.description: In 1.16.0, `composed_configuration` referenced `SnmpViewOidAttributes` before it was defined, so importing the SNMP models failed with `NameError`. The class is now defined first. Use 1.16.1 instead of 1.16.0.

entries.title: SNMP models reworked: groups added, communities slimmed, views hold OIDs
entries.description: `Snmp` gains `groups` (`SnmpGroupAttributes`: `name`, `access`, `ipv4acl`, `ipv6acl`, `users`, `views`); `SnmpCommunityAttributes` keeps only the community string plus `ipv4acl`/`ipv6acl` references, so `access`, `view`, `ipv4_acl`, `ipv6_acl` and `source_interface` are gone. A view (`SnmpViewAttributes`) now holds many OIDs in `oids`, `SnmpServerAttributes` gains `group`, and the SNMP classes are renamed with an `Attributes` suffix. This release does not import; use 1.16.1.

entries.title: Reference classes available from `acex_devkit.models.reference`
entries.description: `Reference`, `ReferenceTo`, `ReferenceFrom`, `RenderedReference`, `Metadata` and `MetadataValueType` now live in their own module so model files can import them without a circular import. They are still importable from `composed_configuration`.

entries.title: VTY lines can reference an ACL: `VtyLine.ipv4acl`, `ipv6acl`, `acl_direction`
entries.description: `VtyLine` gains `ipv4acl` and `ipv6acl` (a `Reference` to an ACL object), `acl_direction` (`in` or `out`) and `acl_network_instance`. The comments in the model mark them as Cisco-only.

entries.title: `Acl.ipv4_acls`, `ipv6_acls` and `acl_entries` default to `{}` instead of `None`
entries.description: On `Acl`, `Ipv4AclAttributes` and `Ipv6AclAttributes` the dictionaries are empty by default. Code that tests these fields with `is None` to mean "no ACLs" must test for emptiness instead.

entries.title: Netflow models are keyed by `name`; collectors reference records and exporters
entries.description: `NetflowRecordAttributes`, `NetflowRecordIpv4Match`, `NetflowCollectorAttributes`, `NetflowExporterOptions`, `NetflowExporterAttributes` and `NetflowGlobalConfigAttributes` are now `ContainerEntry`s with a required `name`; `NetflowExporterAttributes` is identified by `name` instead of `address`. `NetflowCollectorAttributes.netflow_record` and `netflow_exporter` are replaced by `records` and `exporters`, dicts of `Reference`. Config maps and renderers using the old fields must be updated.

entries.title: `SnmpCommunity.clients` and `VTPAttributes.primary_server` removed
entries.description: Both vendor-specific fields (`clients` was marked Juniper-specific, `primary_server` Cisco-proprietary) are gone from the vendor-neutral models. Config using them must move to the new augments, or drop them.

entries.title: Vendor-specific augments: `AugmentAttributes` and `Augmentable`
entries.description: New `AugmentAttributes` base (accepts extra fields, so backend-defined subclasses round-trip through JSON) and `Augmentable` mixin with an `augments` dict. `Interface`, `InterfaceTemplateAttributes`, `SnmpCommunity` and `VTPAttributes` are now `Augmentable`; a driver reads vendor-only settings from `augments` by augment `type`.

entries.title: DNS servers in the composed configuration: `System.dns`
entries.description: `System` gains `dns: Dns` (default `Dns()`), with `dns_servers: dict[str, DnsServerAttributes]`. Each `DnsServerAttributes` is keyed by `address` and has `port`, `source_interface` (a `Reference`) and `network_instance`.

entries.title: `InterfaceTemplateAttributes.stp_portfast` added
entries.description: Interface templates gain `stp_portfast: AttributeValue[bool] | None`, documented in the model as Cisco-explicit and rendered to `spanning-tree portfast`. `stp_edge_port` is documented as the 802.1w edge-port setting and renders to the same command on Cisco.

entries.title: Interface templates: `ComposedConfiguration.interface_templates`
entries.description: New `InterfaceTemplateAttributes` (keyed by `name`) holds reusable interface settings: L2/L1 (switchport, VLANs, `speed`, `duplex`, `auto_mdix`), spanning-tree, LACP, `storm_control` and link-status logging. `ComposedConfiguration` gains `interface_templates`, and `Interface` gains `interface_template` (a `Reference`).

entries.title: Interfaces get storm control, `dtp_negotiation`, link-status logging and traps
entries.description: `Interface` gains `storm_control` (`StormControlAttributes`: `broadcast_pps`, `multicast_pps`, `unknown_unicast_pps`, `action`), `dtp_negotiation` (`False` renders `switchport nonegotiate` on Cisco), `logging_link_status` and `snmp_link_status_trap`. `EthernetCsmacdInterface` also gains `auto_mdix`.

entries.title: Netflow collector references its record and exporter; two fields renamed
entries.description: `NetflowCollectorAttributes` gains `netflow_record` and `netflow_exporter` (string references to the record and exporter). `NetflowExporterOptions.sampler_table_timeout` (int) becomes `sampler_table` (bool), and `NetflowExporterAttributes.format` (`NetflowFormat`) becomes `netflow_format` (`str`). Config written against 1.10.0 must use the new names.

entries.title: Early sFlow models exist but are not yet in the composed tree
entries.description: `Sflow` and `SflowCollectorAttributes` exist, but `Sampling.sflow` is commented out, so sFlow cannot be set on a `ComposedConfiguration` yet. The PR describes them as a reference that is untested and needs more work.

entries.title: Netflow configuration: `ComposedConfiguration.sampling.netflow`
entries.description: `ComposedConfiguration` gains `sampling: Sampling`, whose `netflow` holds a global `config`, `records`, `exporters` and `collectors` (the monitor, named after OpenConfig). New models include `NetflowRecordAttributes`, `NetflowExporterAttributes`, `NetflowCollectorAttributes` and `NetflowFormat` (`IPFIX`, `NetFlow v9`, `NetFlow v5`).

entries.title: `TransportBase.get_lldp_neighbors()` for LLDP/CDP neighbour collection
entries.description: New optional method `get_lldp_neighbors(node, connection, **kwargs)`; implement it to return a list of dicts with `local_interface`, `remote_device`, `remote_interface` and `discovery_protocol`. It is not abstract: transports that do not implement it raise `NotImplementedError`.

entries.title: `TransportBase.session()` lets a caller reuse one connection
entries.description: `TransportBase.session(connection, **kwargs)` is a context manager that yields the transport. The default does nothing, so each method still connects per call; a driver can override it to hold one connection open across several operations.

entries.title: Small device services in the composed configuration: `System.services`
entries.description: `System` gains `services: Services` (default `Services()`), a model with `name`, `http` and `https` (web GUI access) attributes.

entries.title: Config normalizer: `BaseNormalizer` and driver `normalize()`/`mask()`
entries.description: New package `acex_devkit.normalizer` with `BaseNormalizer` (subclass and declare `line_rules`, `block_rules`, `rewrite_rules`), `LineRule`, `BlockRule`, `RewriteRule` and `NormalizerEngine`. A driver sets `normalizer_class`; `NetworkElementDriver.normalize(raw)` then drops non-intent lines such as timestamps, and `mask(raw)` rewrites secrets to `<REDACTED>`. Without a normalizer both return the input unchanged.

entries.title: `TransportBase` requires `get_config` and `send_config`, not four old methods
entries.description: The abstract methods `connect`, `send`, `verify` and `rollback` are removed. A transport must implement `get_config(node, connection, **kwargs) -> str` (full running configuration) and `send_config(node, connection, commands, **kwargs) -> str`, each taking the `NodeListItem` and `ManagementConnection`; there is no persistent session state in the contract. Existing transports must be rewritten, or they cannot be instantiated.

entries.title: Optional `TransportBase.execute()` and the `ManagementConnection` model
entries.description: `TransportBase.execute(node, connection, commands, **kwargs)` runs arbitrary commands and returns one output string per command; it raises `NotImplementedError` unless a driver implements it. `ManagementConnection` (`id`, `node_id`, `primary`, `connection_type`, `target_ip`) and `ConnectionType` (`ssh`, `telnet`) are exported from `acex_devkit.models`.

entries.title: `NodeResponse.asset` can be an `AssetCluster`, chosen by `type`
entries.description: `NodeResponse.asset` is now `Asset | AssetCluster`, discriminated by a `type` field (`asset` or `asset_cluster`). `Asset` gains `type`, and new `AssetCluster` (`name`, `ned_id`, `assets`) and `AssetClusterAsset` (with `cluster_index`) are in `acex_devkit.models.node_response`. Code that read `node.asset.serial_number` must check `type` first. This is also a backend and client API change.

entries.title: Node response models no longer invent default values
entries.description: In `node_response`, `LogicalNodeResponse` fields (`hostname`, `role`, `site`, `sequence`, `configuration`) now default to `None` instead of `R1`, `core`, `HQ`, `1` and an empty `ComposedConfiguration`. `NodeBase.asset_ref_type` and `status` default to `None`, and every `Asset` field is `Optional`. Callers must handle `None` where they relied on the old defaults or required fields.

entries.title: `AssetRefType.assetcluster` is now `asset_cluster`
entries.description: The enum member `AssetRefType.assetcluster` (value `"assetcluster"`) is renamed to `AssetRefType.asset_cluster` (value `"asset_cluster"`). Code or stored data that uses the old string must be updated; this value is also sent in backend and client API payloads.

entries.title: `EthernetCsmacdInterface.cdp_enabled` removed
entries.description: Per-interface CDP is no longer set through `cdp_enabled` on `EthernetCsmacdInterface`; list the interface under `cdp.interfaces` instead. Config using `cdp_enabled` must be changed.

entries.title: CDP configuration: `ComposedConfiguration.cdp`
entries.description: `ComposedConfiguration` gains `cdp: CdpConfigAttributes` with `enabled`, `transmit_interval`, `hold_time`, `advertise_v2` and `interfaces` (a dict of `Reference`). The interfaces CDP applies to are listed here.

entries.title: `EthernetCsmacdInterface.lldp_enabled` removed
entries.description: Per-interface LLDP is no longer set with `lldp_enabled` on `EthernetCsmacdInterface`; the interface is listed under `lldp.interfaces`. Config using `lldp_enabled` must be changed.

entries.title: `NodeListItem` for node listings; `NodeResponse.id`
entries.description: New `NodeListItem` in `acex_devkit.models` is a list shape with the node's fields plus denormalised `hostname`, `site`, `vendor`, `os`, `ned_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`. `NodeResponse` gains `id`.

entries.title: LLDP configuration: `LldpConfigAttributes` on `ComposedConfiguration.lldp`
entries.description: `ComposedConfiguration.lldp` changes from an empty `Lldp` placeholder to `LldpConfigAttributes`, with `enabled`, `transmit_interval`, `hold_time`, `system_name`, `suppress_tlv_advertisement` and `interfaces` (a dict of `Reference`). The `Lldp` class is removed.

entries.title: DHCP snooping and relay in the composed configuration: `System.dhcp`
entries.description: `System` gains `dhcp: Dhcp` with `snooping` (`DHCPSnoopingAttributes`: `enabled`, `vlans`, `trust_interfaces`, `option82`) and `relay` (`DhcpRelay.relay_servers`, keyed by `address`, each with `network_instance` and the `interfaces` it relays for).

entries.title: Node `status` and timestamps: `NodeStatus`, `created_at`, `updated_at`
entries.description: New `NodeStatus` enum (`planned`, `init`, `active`, `decommissioned`) and `NodeBase.status` (default `planned`). `Node` and `NodeResponse` gain `created_at` and `updated_at`; on `NodeResponse` `created_at` is required. This is also a backend and client API change.

entries.title: Per-interface `redirects`, `proxy_arp`, `lldp_enabled` and `cdp_enabled`
entries.description: `Interface` gains `redirects` and `proxy_arp` (the model notes Cisco true = yes, Juniper true = unrestricted). `EthernetCsmacdInterface` gains `lldp_enabled` and `cdp_enabled`.

entries.title: VTP configuration: `System.vtp`
entries.description: `System` gains `vtp: VTP`, whose `config` is a `VTPAttributes` with `domain_name`, `mode` (`server`, `client`, `transparent`, `off`), `primary_server`, `version` (1-3), `password` and `password_hashed`.

entries.title: `SnmpServer.address` is optional
entries.description: `SnmpServer.address` changes from required to `AttributeValue[str] | None` (default `None`), so an SNMP trap server can be built, for example by a parser, without an address.

entries.title: `vlan_id` on L3/loopback/sub/management interfaces is an `AttributeValue[int]`
entries.description: `L3IpvlanInterface`, `SoftwareLoopbackInterface`, `SubInterface` and `ManagementInterface` change `vlan_id` from `int | None` to `AttributeValue[int] | None`. `AuthorizedKey.algorithm` and `public_key` are likewise `AttributeValue`s and optional, and the `metadata` field is removed from `Vlan` and `Interface`. Read `.value` and stop passing `metadata`.

entries.title: `ContainerEntry` mixin: container models declare `identity_fields`
entries.description: New `acex_devkit.models.container_entry.ContainerEntry`. A model used as a value in a dict container must declare `identity_fields: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]]`: field names whose values identify the entry, or `()` to use the dict key. A subclass without it raises `TypeError` at class creation. All composed-configuration container models (interfaces, VLANs, NTP servers, ACLs, SNMP, AAA, spanning tree) now do this.

entries.title: `ConfigDiffer` matches container entries by `identity_fields`, not dict key
entries.description: Entries that are `ContainerEntry`s are paired between desired and observed by their identity-field values, so `Gi0/0/1` and `GigabitEthernet0/0/1` can be the same interface. Singletons are matched by path, and a leaf is now any model with a direct `AttributeValue` field. Reported `path`, `component_name` and the set of changes can differ from before.

entries.title: The differ ignores `AttributeValue` metadata: equality compares `value` only
entries.description: `AttributeValue` now defines `__eq__` and `__hash__` on `value`, so two attributes with the same value are equal whatever their metadata, and the differ no longer reports metadata-only differences. This lets a parsed configuration be compared with a desired one.

entries.title: `RemoteServer.transfer` renamed to `transport`
entries.description: The field that selects how a remote logging server is reached is now `RemoteServer.transport` (`AttributeValue[str] | None`); `transfer` no longer exists. Config and templates using `transfer` must be updated.

entries.title: Logging `remote_servers`, `vty` and `files` are typed container classes
entries.description: On `LoggingComponents`, `remote_servers`, `vty` and `files` are no longer `Dict`s but `RemoteServers`, `VtyLines` and `LogFiles`, holding the dict in `servers`, `lines` and `files`. Defaults are empty instances instead of `None`. Code that indexed `logging.vty[<key>]` must use `logging.vty.lines[<key>]`, and likewise for the other two.

entries.title: Collection fields in the composed configuration default to `{}`, not `None`
entries.description: Dict collections such as `Ntp.servers`, `Ssh.host_keys`, `Snmp.users`, `Snmp.trap_servers`, `NetworkInstance.vlans` and the AAA `config`/`events` dicts default to an empty dict again after 1.2.0 made them `None`. Code that tests them with `is None` must test for emptiness.

entries.title: `ConfigDiffer` walks the models by type instead of dumping them to dicts
entries.description: `ConfigDiffer.diff` now discovers components by introspecting the `ComposedConfiguration` models (entries of `Dict[str, BaseModel]` fields are components) rather than scanning a dumped dict and a fixed `IGNORED_KEYS` list. `ComponentChange.before` and `after` are the model instances and `before_dict`/`after_dict` come from `model_dump()`. `AttributeChange.before` and `after` are typed `Any`, so they hold plain values.

entries.title: Composed configuration values are all `AttributeValue`; defaults are unset
entries.description: Raw fields in the spanning-tree, logging, AAA, SNMP and interface models (for example `RemoteServer.port`, `FileLogging.facility`, the `stp_*` interface fields, `aaaTacacsAttributes.port`) become `AttributeValue[T] | None`. Built-in defaults such as port `514`, transport `udp`, TACACS port `49` and `stp_edge_port=False` are replaced by `None`, and dict collections default to `None`. Code that read plain values or relied on the defaults must unwrap `.value` and handle `None`.

entries.title: SNMP `name` and `event_name` fields are optional `AttributeValue`s
entries.description: `SnmpServer.name`, `TrapEvent.name` and `TrapEvent.event_name` are no longer required plain values, and `RouteTarget.value` becomes `AttributeValue[str] | None`. Construct them with `AttributeValue(value=...)` or leave them out.

entries.title: `Diff.summary()` key `total` renamed to `total_changes`
entries.description: The `total` key in the dict returned by `Diff.summary()` is now `total_changes`; the value is unchanged (added + removed + changed). `Diff.get_changes_by_type()` now compares the class name of `component_type` with the string given. Callers reading `summary()["total"]` must use the new key.

entries.title: `Diff` reports compliance: `compliant_count` and `compliance_percentage`
entries.description: `Diff` gains `total_desired` and `total_observed` (filled by `ConfigDiffer`) and the computed `compliant_count` and `compliance_percentage` (100.0 when nothing is desired). `summary()` includes all four. `ComponentChange.component_type` is serialised as the class name, and `component_type_name` gives it directly.

entries.title: `Snmp.config` is a dict of `SnmpConfig`, default `{}`
entries.description: `Snmp.config` changes from a single `SnmpConfig` to `Dict[str, SnmpConfig]`, like the other SNMP collections. Code that read `snmp.config.<field>` must index the dict by key.

entries.title: `System.snmp` defaults to an empty `Snmp()` instead of `{}`
entries.description: `System.snmp` was initialised with an empty dict, which is not an `Snmp` model and caused errors when the field was accessed. It now defaults to `Snmp()`.

entries.title: IPv4 and IPv6 ACL models: `Acl`, `Ipv4AclAttributes`, `Ipv6AclAttributes`
entries.description: New module `acex_devkit.models.acl_model`. `Acl` holds `ipv4_acls` and `ipv6_acls`; each ACL has a `name` and `acl_entries` with `sequence_id`, `action`, `protocol` (`AclProtoclOptions`), source/destination address and port, `dscp`, `log` and `description`. `Acl` replaces the empty placeholder in `ComposedConfiguration`.

entries.title: `ipaddress` added to the package dependencies
entries.description: `pyproject.toml` now lists `ipaddress` as a dependency, because the ACL models use `IPv4Network` and `IPv6Network`.

entries.title: `AttributeValue` serialises IP address and network values as strings
entries.description: Values of type `IPv4Address`, `IPv6Address`, `IPv4Network`, `IPv6Network`, `IPv4Interface` and `IPv6Interface` are now converted to `str` when an `AttributeValue` is serialised. Before, the raw object was returned and JSON serialisation raised `PydanticSerializationError`.

entries.title: AAA events, global `enabled` and single-string `method`
entries.description: `aaaAuthorization.events` and `aaaAccounting.events` are dicts of event entries with an `event` attribute, `aaaAccounting.config` is a dict of methods, and `TripleA.config` is an `aaaGlobalAttributes` with `enabled` (default `False`). Authentication, authorization and accounting `method` is an `AttributeValue[str]`, so a list of methods must be given as a string.

entries.title: AAA server groups hold their TACACS and RADIUS servers
entries.description: `aaaServerGroupAttributes.tacacs` and `radius` change from a single `Reference` to dicts of `aaaTacacsAttributes` / `aaaRadiusAttributes`, and `TripleA.tacacs` and `TripleA.radius` are removed. The server models drop `aaaBaseClass`, replace `source_address` with `source_interface` (a `Reference`) and gain `server_group`. Config that defined servers under `aaa` directly must move them into a group.

entries.title: `DiffNode`, `DiffOp` and `ConfigDiffer.apply_diff` removed from `configdiffer`
entries.description: `acex_devkit.configdiffer` now exports `ConfigDiffer`, `Diff`, `ComponentChange`, `ComponentDiffOp` and `AttributeChange`. `DiffNode`, `DiffOp` and `apply_diff` are no longer part of the public package; the old implementation was kept in `old_configdiffer` and `old_diff`. Code importing the removed names must switch to the component-based diff.

entries.title: `ConfigDiffer.diff` takes `ComposedConfiguration`s and returns component changes
entries.description: `ConfigDiffer.diff(desired_config=..., observed_config=...)` now takes two `ComposedConfiguration` objects and returns a `Diff` with `added`, `removed` and `changed` lists of `ComponentChange` (`op`, `path`, `component_type`, `component_name`, `before`, `after`, `before_dict`, `after_dict`, `changed_attributes`). The earlier `DiffNode` tree is no longer returned. Drivers can use this to render a patch per component.

entries.title: `Command` and `Context` models for rendered patch commands
entries.description: New `acex_devkit.configdiffer.command` with `Command` (a `command` string with its `Context`) and `Context` (a `path` tuple). Both are frozen, so instances are immutable and hashable.

entries.title: Spanning-tree `config` fields are dicts keyed by name
entries.description: `SpanningTree.config`, `RSTPConfig.config` and `MSTPConfig.config` change from a single attributes object to `Dict[str, ...]` (default `{}`). Code that read `stp.rstp.config.<field>` must index the dict first.

entries.title: `ComposedConfiguration.stp` defaults to an empty `SpanningTree()`
entries.description: The default of `ComposedConfiguration.stp` was `{}`, which is not a `SpanningTree`. It is now `SpanningTree()`, whose `rstp`, `mstp` and `rapidpvst` are optional, so a node without spanning-tree config carries only `stp` and not each protocol's defaults.

entries.title: Node models importable from `acex_devkit.models`: `NodeResponse`, `Asset`
entries.description: `acex_devkit.models.node_response` defines `LogicalNodeResponse`, `Asset`, `AssetRefType` (`asset`, `assetcluster`), `NodeBase`, `Node` and `NodeResponse`, and `acex_devkit.models` exports `NodeResponse` and `LogicalNodeResponse`. Before this release the module used `BaseModel`, `Field`, `AssetRefType` and `AssetResponse` without defining or importing them.

entries.title: Login and MOTD banners: `SystemConfig.login_banner` and `motd_banner`
entries.description: `SystemConfig` gains `login_banner` and `motd_banner`, both `AttributeValue[str] | None`.

entries.title: Static routes: `NetworkInstance.protocols.static_routes`
entries.description: `NetworkInstance` gains `protocols: Protocols` with `static_routes`, a dict of `StaticRoute` (`prefix`, `route_name`, `network_instance`, `next_hops`). Each `StaticRouteNextHop` has `next_hop` (an address or interface), `index` and `metric`.

entries.title: `EthernetCsmacdInterface.negotiation` for auto-negotiation
entries.description: `EthernetCsmacdInterface` gains `negotiation: AttributeValue[bool] | None` (default `None`, so no setting is implied).

entries.title: `AttributeValue[T]` and `ExternalValue` wrap configuration values
entries.description: Configuration attributes are `AttributeValue[T]`: a `value` that is either concrete or an `ExternalValue` reference resolved by a plugin, plus `metadata`. Raw values are accepted on input and wrapped. `ExternalValue` is a `sqlmodel` table, and `sqlmodel` is not declared as a dependency until 2.1.1.

entries.title: `ConfigDiffer` compares two configurations: `Diff`, `DiffNode`, `DiffOp`
entries.description: `acex_devkit.configdiffer.ConfigDiffer.diff(desired_config=..., observed_config=...)` returns a `Diff` whose `root` is a tree of `DiffNode`s (`add`, `remove`, `change`), with `is_empty()` and `summary()`. `apply_diff(config, diff)` applies a diff to a `ComposedConfiguration` or dict. `deepdiff` becomes a dependency.

entries.title: `Ned` model and a first `NodeResponse`
entries.description: New `Ned` (`name`, `package_name`, `version`, `description`, `filename`) in `acex_devkit.models.ned`. `acex_devkit.models.node_response` is added, but it is incomplete in this release: it uses names it does not import, so use 1.0.5 or later.

entries.title: Composed configuration models: `ComposedConfiguration` and its components
entries.description: New `acex_devkit.models.composed_configuration` with `ComposedConfiguration` (`system`, `acl`, `lldp`, `lacp`, `interfaces`, `network_instances`, `stp`), the interface types (`EthernetCsmacdInterface`, `Ieee8023adLagInterface`, `L3IpvlanInterface`, `SoftwareLoopbackInterface`, `SubInterface`, `ManagementInterface`), `System` (AAA, logging, NTP, SSH, SNMP) and spanning-tree models. This is the device-independent structure a driver renders and parses.

entries.title: `acex_devkit.drivers` imports again
entries.description: In 1.0.0 `drivers/base.py` imported `acex_devkit.models.logical_node`, a module that did not exist, so importing the driver base classes failed. The import is removed and `NetworkElementDriver.render` takes `logical_node` as an untyped forward reference.

entries.title: Driver base classes: `NetworkElementDriver`, `RendererBase`, `TransportBase`
entries.description: First release of `acex-devkit`. A driver subclasses `NetworkElementDriver` and sets `renderer_class`, `transport_class` and `parser_class`; a transport implements `connect`, `send`, `verify` and `rollback`, a renderer `render(model, asset)` and a parser `parse(configuration)`. Requires Python `^3.13` and `pydantic ^2.12.5`. Importing `acex_devkit.drivers` failed in this release because of a missing module; see 1.0.1.

entries.title: Exceptions and protocols: `DriverException` family and `Renderable`/`Parseable`
entries.description: `acex_devkit.exceptions` defines `AcexDevkitException`, `MethodNotImplemented`, `DriverException` and its subclasses `ConnectionError`, `ConfigurationError`, `VerificationError`, `RenderingError` and `ParsingError`. `acex_devkit.types` has the runtime-checkable protocols `Renderable`, `Parseable` and `Transportable`.
